concept.prompt: photorealistic AAA sci-fi game character render, detailed weathered PBR materials, dark moody low-key lighting with a strong cool rim light, plain dark grey studio background, no holographic panels. Subject: Rook, the captain of a rival prospecting crew, a lean athletic man in his thirties with light tanned skin, a confident cocky grin, a thin scar across his right cheek, short messy dark brown hair, light stubble, a scuffed armored mining suit: pale off-white armor plates worn and stained with rust-brown patches and scratches, edged with brown leather trim, over a dark charcoal quilted undersuit, a thick dark rolled neck seal ring around the collar, big rounded pale shoulder plates, a pale chest plate with a round blue crew patch with a white star and small dark vents, a dark brown leather belt with small pouches, pale armored thigh plates, round pale knee guards, tall pale shin armor, heavy dark brown boots, dark padded gloves with pale knuckle plates, no helmet, standing in a relaxed A-pose, both arms held out and away from the body at 45 degrees with a clear gap between the arms and the torso, empty open hands with spread fingers, nothing in the hands, nothing on the back, no holster, no weapon, nothing strapped to the legs, legs slightly apart, feet flat, full body visible from head to boots, centered, single character, front view, facing the camera.
